# Hwan'Story

> Personal blog service at {{SITE_URL}} (API at {{API_URL}}). Accounts own blogs; blogs have markdown posts (public / private / draft / scheduled), series, tags, comments and reactions.

AI agents: read the full guide before doing anything. It covers sign-in without pasting secrets (device flow), who you are acting as, reading all of the owner's posts (including drafts), writing and editing posts as markdown, reviewing existing posts (summary / title / tags / broken links), series, image upload, and the rules (new posts are drafts unless told otherwise; never print tokens; revoke the token when done). The guide is written in Korean; commands are copy-paste ready for this server.

## Docs

- [Agent guide]({{API_URL}}/agents.md): the complete how-to and API reference (markdown)
- [Rendered guide]({{SITE_URL}}/agents): the same guide as a web page
- [OpenAPI]({{API_URL}}/v3/api-docs): full API specification (Swagger UI at {{API_URL}}/swagger-ui/index.html)

## Tools

- [Device-flow sign-in helper, bash]({{API_URL}}/cli/login.sh): `bash login.sh start "client name" posts`, then `bash login.sh wait`; stores the token in ~/.config/hwanstory/auth-header without printing it
- [Device-flow sign-in helper, PowerShell]({{API_URL}}/cli/login.ps1)

## Public feeds

- [RSS]({{API_URL}}/rss): latest public posts across all blogs ({{API_URL}}/rss/{blogId} per blog)
- [Sitemap]({{API_URL}}/sitemap.xml)
